mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cod Defb stimulates phagocytic activity of cod head kidney leucocytes in vitro, with the reported Figure 9 response supporting immune-cell functional modulation.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Cod Defb is source-supported as a mature beta-defensin peptide with six conserved cysteines, predicted beta-defensin disulfide connectivity, and mass-spectrometry coverage of the mature sequence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Structural model supports defensin classification; it is not direct proof of a specific antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Defb transcript is induced in head kidney after live Vibrio anguillarum challenge, supporting infection-responsive innate immune context.
